The path has five distinct vertices: (64.09,29.48), (52.02,22.69), (48.18,29.51), (60.25,36.30), and back to (64.09,29.48).  
Five vertices means it is a pentagon.  
Checking visually: The coordinates form a closed shape with five sides, not symmetric like a kite, not three sides (triangle), not four sides (rectangle, trapezoid), etc.  

Final answer: (G)
